entry.title: Kids Kingdom: custody to the town: Town Meeting, 2026-05-02
entry.summary: Article 33: transfer care, custody and control of part of Kids Kingdom land from school committee to select board (2/3 vote) — passed 100-9

entry.title: Kids Kingdom: custody to the town: Finance Committee, 2026-04-02
entry.summary: Find no financial impact on transfer of Kids Kingdom land to select board — passed

entry.title: Kids Kingdom: custody to the town: School Committee, 2026-04-01
entry.summary: Co-sponsor (re-affirm) the warrant article for Kids Kingdom with the select board — passed

entry.title: Kids Kingdom: custody to the town: Select Board, 2026-03-31
entry.summary: Recommend approval of the Kids Kingdom article (re-vote; captioned again as Article GG) — passed 5-0, unanimous

entry.title: Kids Kingdom: custody to the town: Select Board, 2026-03-17
entry.summary: Recommend approval of the Kids Kingdom transfer article. — passed unanimously

entry.title: Kids Kingdom: custody to the town: Select Board, 2026-02-17
entry.summary: Discussion of warrant articles for 2026 annual town meeting (Kids Kingdom, notice of town meeting bylaw, 300th anniversary, PAC, trust fund commission, open space committee, capital cleanup)

entry.title: Kids Kingdom: custody to the town: Select Board, 2026-02-03
entry.summary: Chair will reach out to the school committee about crafting a joint warrant article on the Kids Kingdom relocation.

entry.title: Kids Kingdom: custody to the town: School Committee, 2026-01-21
entry.summary: The draft turf field and Kids Kingdom warrant articles were treated as discussion only tonight, with the language considered ready for the town to act on; no formal committee vote was taken on the article text.

entry.title: Kids Kingdom: custody to the town: Select Board, 2026-01-13
entry.summary: Board will pursue a joint select board/school committee warrant article on Kids Kingdom custody transfer, largely reusing the special town meeting language.

entry.title: Kids Kingdom: custody to the town: School Committee, 2026-01-07
entry.summary: Motion to remit care, custody, and control of Kids Kingdom to the town — passed

entry.title: Kids Kingdom: custody to the town: Select Board, 2025-12-09
entry.summary: Board leaning toward sending a letter to the school committee affirming the school committee's care, custody and control of Kids Kingdom, paired with a rough conceptual site sketch to inform further discussion, rather than issuing it unilaterally.

entry.title: Kids Kingdom: custody to the town: Town Meeting, 2025-11-18
entry.summary: pass over article 11 (Kids Kingdom transfer to select board) — passed by majority

entry.title: Kids Kingdom: custody to the town: School Committee, 2025-10-15
entry.summary: School committee draft goals: Turkey Hill direction, capital plan, Kids Kingdom, playgrounds, budget rubric/audit

entry.title: Kids Kingdom: custody to the town: School Committee, 2025-02-05
entry.summary: Superintendent will tell the town manager the committee is split on the Kids Kingdom move and will convene a joint discussion (school committee, Council on Aging, facilities director, library) before any proposal returns for a vote.
